sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety candidates inside the current-week window; GFlowRL was selected from the unified table.
The arXiv abstract, HTML paper, experiments, appendix results, and linked code entry were read before writing the Markdown analysis.
The article explains the learned partition failure, in-batch Monte Carlo estimator, importance sampling, asymmetric clipping, benchmarks, ablations, and MoE transfer.
The write-up separates fixed-point analysis from convergence guarantees and calls out group-size, reward-noise, and code-release limitations.
The article positions GFlowRL against GRPO, PPO, FOR, FlowRL, and FlowRL-RandomLogZ using the paper's reported tables.
The Markdown uses tables, formulas, pseudocode, and short sectioned bullets; no external image URLs are embedded.
